request.answer: Overdue amounts accrue interest at the rate of 1.5% per month, or the highest rate permitted by law if lower, from the due date until paid. If Provider fails to meet this commitment in a calendar month, Customer will recieve a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly fee for each full hour of unavailability, up to a maximum of 10% of the monthly fee for that month.
